qualification.details: Guest Instructor (Electrician): B. Voc/Degree in Electrical Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/university OR 03 years Diploma in Electrical Engineering from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Electrician. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (Fitter): B. Voc/Degree in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Fitter OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Tool & Die maker (PT, J&E) or Tool & Die maker (Die & Mould). Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (MMV): B. Voc/Degree in Automobile/ Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Automobile/ Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Mechanical Motor Vehicle. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Must possess valid LMV Driving License. Guest Instructor (Welder): B. Voc/Degree in Mechanical/ Metrology/ Production Engineering/ Mechatronics from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Mechanical and allied from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Welder. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (Solar Technician): B. Voc/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Electrical/ Electrical & Electronics Engineering from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Solar Technician. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (COPA): B. Voc/Degree in Computer Science/ IT from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR PG in Computer Science/ Computer Application/ IT from UGC recognized University OR Bachelor in Computer Science/ Computer Application/ IT or PGDCA from UGC recognized University OR 03 years Diploma in Computer Science/ IT from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of COPA/ Any trade in IT-ITeS Sector trade. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (Cosmetology): B. Voc/Degree in the relevant field from AICTE/UGC recognized Engineering College/ university OR 03 years Diploma in Beauty Culture/ Cosmetology from AICTE/recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/NAC passed in the Trade of Hair & Skin Care/Cosmetology. Essential Qualification: Relevant Regular / RPL variants of National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Govt. ITI Jajpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Guest Instructor posts at Govt. ITI Jajpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Instructor posts at Govt. ITI Jajpur is scheduled for 12 August 2026. Candidates should reach the venue between 09:30 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Instructor position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for the Guest Instructor positions at Govt. ITI Jajpur for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor role?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications include B.Voc/Degree/Diploma/NTC/NAC in the relevant trade, along with specified years of experience and CITS training.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years as of 31st July 2026. There is no upper age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Guest Instructor position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Instructor position will be paid on an hourly basis. Specific details regarding the hourly rate are not provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q7. Which trades are covered under the Guest Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers various trades including Electrician, Fitter, MMV, Welder, Solar Technician, COPA, and Cosmetology.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Bio-data, original documents for verification, one set of self-attested Xerox copies, two passport-size photographs, and Aadhaar card Xerox copy.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Govt. Industrial Training Institute Jajpur located?
faq.answer: Govt. Industrial Training Institute Jajpur is located in Jajpur, Odisha, with the pincode 755009.
